title: Impossible Gl* Bridge
script:
local Library = loadstring(Game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wizard"))()
local Window = Library:NewWindow("by Vittelle")

local Tab = Window:NewSection("Script -->")

Tab:CreateToggle("Auto Changer Couleurs", function(no)
    _G.AutoChangeColors = no
    while _G.AutoChangeColors do
        wait(1) -- Intervalle de temps entre les changements
        for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Part") then
                if obj.Name == "Vidrio templado" then
                    obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
                elseif obj.Name == "Vidrio roto" then
                    obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
